competitorFacts.text: The Kaggle account mithilavakde publishes a model called mdlARC under the displayed name Mithil A Vakde.
The observed nvbanana roster contains cpmpml and darraghdog. Those two handles also appear in NVARC3 on the ARC-AGI-3 board; these remain separate competition entries.
Jean-François Puget’s public GitHub profile identifies him as CPMP and links directly to the Kaggle account cpmpml.
NVIDIA’s author biography describes Jean-Francois Puget as a director and individual contributor whose team advances agentic AI and showcases NVIDIA tools and expertise in Kaggle competitions.
The ARChitects’ own 2025 solution write-up credits Jan Disselhoff under the Kaggle handle insanitycheck, alongside David Hartmann (dvhrtm) and Daniel Franzen (dfranzen).
The team’s 2025 technical report lists Jan Disselhoff at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz.
The ARC-AGI-2 roster observed on 8 October 2026 includes keithtyser. This observation does not establish a joining date.

discussionThreads.author: darrenamadeusmartin
discussionThreads.reason: Substantive source read and original replies checked; distinguish participant claims from organizer decisions. Logged-out access confirmed.
discussionThreads.summary: Darren Amadeus Martin proposes a deadline extension or GPU change because of grading delays. CPMP argues that a late GPU change would be unfair to teams that spent months tuning for 4xL4. The author replies that fixing the queue is preferable if possible and describes the hardware change as a contingent proposal. No organizer approval was seen.

socialPosts.summary: ARC Prize announced a new 2026 ARC-AGI-2 Kaggle high of 88.06% by Tufa Labs and said a $150,000 bonus would be split among teams scoring above 85%.
socialPosts.whyItMatters: A public-board threshold announcement and major standings lead; the post does not establish a final private score.

wireStories.headline: Khaotic Sethesis slips outside ARC-2 gold

sections.text: Khaotic Sethesis has dropped from 14th to 16th at 48.75, unchanged in the past day, and is now outside the 15 gold places.
The cutoff rose to 49.03, leaving Khaotic Sethesis 0.28 short. Kajetan Schweighofer now holds 15th at 49.03.

wireStories.headline: ARC Prize reports Haiku 5.5 results across all three ARC tests

sections.text: ARC Prize reports Haiku 5.5 scored 61.3% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.085 per task. On ARC-AGI-3, it reached 2.8% at $437 with the provider adapter and 0.5% at $388 with the standard harness. These are model evaluations, separate from Kaggle team standings.
The organization says it omitted the max-reasoning ARC-AGI-2 result: only 74 of 120 tasks completed, with many unfinished attempts exhausting their output budget before producing parseable answers.

sections.text: Arcnights fell from 15th to 17th on the ARC-2 public board, leaving the 15 gold places at an unchanged 48.75. The gold cutoff rose 0.28 in the past day to 49.03; Arcnights is now 0.28 short.
